texts.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetAdj]的环境充满了静电噪声——比我们预测的要多得多。我们向[from.GetName]行动派遣的伪装无人机正在经历间歇性的数据丢失。这会导致我们数据收集风险的显著上升，从而增加了我们暴露的概率。
texts.en: The environment on [excess_noise_country.GetAdj] worlds has become riddled with electrostatic noise - far more than we had anticipated. The disguised drones we have assigned to Operation [from.GetName] are experiencing patchy data loss as a result. This poses significant risks to our data-gathering, and increases our chances of exposure.

texts.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetAdj]的环境再一次充满了静电噪声，我们对这样的频率尚且不能适应。我们向[from.GetName]行动派遣的伪装无人机正在经历间歇性的数据丢失。这会导致我们数据收集风险的显著上升，从而增加了我们暴露的概率。
texts.en: The environment on [excess_noise_country.GetAdj] worlds has once again become riddled with electrostatic noise, in frequencies we are not yet accustomed to. The disguised drones we have assigned to Operation [from.GetName] are experiencing patchy data loss as a result. This poses significant risks to our data-gathering, and increases our chances of exposure.

label.zh: 我们必须尽快继续行动。

tooltips.zh: 存在一定风险，使在[excess_noise_country.GetName]开展的所有特工行动在一段时间内变得更加困难，直到我们的硬件产生了适应性。
tooltips.en: There is a risk that all Operations conducted in the [excess_noise_country.GetName] may become more difficult for a time, until we can adapt our hardware.

texts.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetName]为自己创造的环境产生了比我们预计还要多的静电噪声。我们的伪装无人机时不时经历数据丢失。通过研究这些非正常频域的频率，我们可以对我们的特工无人机进行重新调制，使得其能够维持高功能性并避免在力场中被检测到。
texts.en: The environment which the [excess_noise_country.GetName] creates for itself generates more electrostatic noise than we had anticipated. Our disguised drones are experiencing patchy data loss as a result. By studying these errant frequencies, we can re-tune our operative drones to maintain higher function and avoid detection 'in the field'.

texts.zh: 我们的研究努力取得了回报，新的电磁屏蔽护盾参数已经分发到了我们位于[excess_noise_country.GetName]的间谍网中。我们[fromfromfrom.GetName]行动的工作将不会在遇到阻碍。
texts.en: Our research efforts have paid off, and specifications for new shielding against electromagnetic interference are being distributed throughout our operative network in the [excess_noise_country.GetName]. Our efforts on Operation [fromfromfrom.GetName] should no longer be hindered by excess static.

texts.zh: 在[excess_noise_country.GetName]上的电磁杂波已经导致了我们的一些特工的不可逆转的数据损失。[event_target:excess_noise_operation.GetName]行动或许可以继续，但我们的工作将被拖延——需要相当的工作量来保证我们的数据可信。
texts.en: Electrostatic noise in the [excess_noise_country.GetName] has now caused irreparable data loss amongst some of our drones. Operation [event_target:excess_noise_operation.GetName] may continue, but our efforts are being hindered - such is the scale of backlogged demands upon our data validation processes.
